pages.title: Value Laptop 14 — Everyday Laptop
pages.meta_description: An affordable laptop for everyday use.

headings.text: Great for students on a budget

pages.main_text: The Value Laptop 14 is a budget laptop for students. Priced at ₹45,000, it comes with 8GB RAM and 256GB storage. Ideal for browsing and everyday use. Affordable and reliable.

pages.title: Pro Laptop X — Premium Laptop for Professionals
pages.meta_description: A premium laptop with a flagship processor and OLED display.
pages.main_text: The Pro Laptop X is a premium laptop with an aluminium body and OLED display, priced at ₹95,000. It ships with 16GB RAM and a flagship processor, making it excellent for programming and software development. Popular with professionals and developers.

pages.title: Campus Laptop 13 — Laptop with 16GB RAM
pages.meta_description: Laptop with 16GB RAM and long battery life.
pages.main_text: Campus Laptop 13 comes with 16GB RAM and 512GB storage, priced at ₹58,000. Long battery life for a full day of classes.

pages.title: Student Discount Program
pages.meta_description: Verify your student ID for a discount.
pages.main_text: Get a student discount on any laptop purchase. Verify your student ID at checkout to receive the student pricing offer.

pages.title: Premium Membership Subscription

pages.main_text: Our premium subscription plan gives you free shipping and early access to sales. No laptop is included in this plan.
